description:
A drum groove built from nested sub-services, where a pipeline's length in time is the sum of the waits inside it.

Four patterns — Straight, Shuffle, Four on the floor and Funk — each a **Bar** made of smaller blocks: a Beat of two hi-hats, Two beats with a snare between them, and so on. The Shuffle is the Straight bar with a swung Beat; the Funk pushes kicks onto the "and" with a block that is sixteenth hi-hats with a kick in the middle.

Every wait is measured in beats. The tempo and the chosen pattern are slots in the outermost scope, the **Groove**. Each bar reads the pattern and a Switch routes the bar into it; every scope inside inherits the Groove's slots, so a Beat reads the tempo from its surroundings without knowing where it is set.

items.placeholder: Each pattern is a bar built from smaller blocks nested inside it. Every wait is in beats; the tempo and the pattern are slots in the outermost scope, and a pattern change lands on the next bar.
